rationale: A defensible orthogonal-leg fusion of the archive's two partial successes with a broader gross-profit-to-price gate, but it is fundamentally an additive recombination of already-tested components rather than a new mechanism, and SUMRANK of a coarse 0–5 persistence count with a continuous burden ratio risks the discrete leg dominating the composite ordering.

This is explicitly a single-operator construction variant of archived CheapWithLowCapitalConsumption (indicator swapped for continuous rank) with no new economic content, exactly the cosmetic re-parameterization the objective warns against.

A well-diagnosed repair that puts the unstable leverage quantity in the numerator over a near-always-positive denominator, though "cheap plus low financial-distress burden" is close to the well-worn safe-value/Piotroski-leverage screen and only modestly extends the archive's burden-ratio family.

The net-cash-to-market-cap valuation channel is genuinely distinct from every book-, earnings-, and cash-flow-yield gate in the archive, and the profitability interaction is economically necessary rather than decorative since net-cash cheapness is dominated by cash-burning firms; the main risk is that the long leg concentrates in small, illiquid, cash-rich names.

The diagnosis (strong alpha, flat slope) is honest and the added profitability leg is substantive rather than cosmetic, but averaging a second rank into the archive's best-alpha signal is as likely to dilute that alpha as to supply a slope, and payout-sustainability screens on high-yield stocks are close to established dividend-safety practice.

Value combined with R&D intensity is a direct rediscovery of the well-published R&D-to-market / intangible-adjusted-value anomaly (Chan-Lakonishok-Sougiannis, Eisfeldt et al.), and the COALESCE-to-zero convention creates a large mass point so the signal effectively reduces to "cheap R&D reporters vs. everyone else."
